meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 安装后，Claude变成Git专家。它会自动将文件变更拆分成多个原子提交（至少每3个文件一个提交），并按照仓库的提交消息风格编写。它还能执行变基、压缩提交和历史搜索（如查找谁写了某段代码）。
howto.when: 当你提到“commit”、“rebase”、“squash”等关键词，或询问代码历史（如谁写的、何时添加）时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这几处修改拆成几个原子提交。
say.note: Claude会分析文件并按规则拆分提交。

say.text: 把这个分支变基到main，并压缩成有序提交。
查一下这个函数是谁写的，在哪个提交引入的。
say.note: Claude会使用git blame和log查找历史。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a Git expert. It automatically splits file changes into multiple atomic commits (at least one per 3 files) and follows the repo's commit message style. It can also rebase, squash commits, and search history (e.g., find who wrote code or when it was added).
howto.when_en: It triggers when you mention keywords like 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', or ask about git history such as who wrote something or when it was added.

say_en.text: Split these changes into several atomic commits.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes files and splits accordingly.

say_en.text: Rebase this branch onto main and squash into ordered commits.
Find who wrote this function and in which commit it was introduced.
say_en.note: Claude uses git blame and log to find history.
